# Sylviane Bahr - Psychotherapy and Coaching

Website: https://www.sylvianebahr.com/

Sylviane Bahr offers humanistic and integrative psychotherapy, Gestalt-informed therapy and ICF-certified coaching in Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona and online.

Primary services:
- Humanistic and integrative psychotherapy
- Gestalt-informed therapy
- Therapy for expats and internationally mobile adults
- Online therapy for French-speaking expats
- Online therapy in English for expats living and working abroad
- Therapy in English, French and Spanish
- Career coaching and professional transition coaching
- Online career coaching for internationally mobile professionals
- Burnout, workplace stress and life-transition support

Location:
- Josep Puig i Cadafalch, 42-44, 08172 Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona, Spain
- Online sessions are available when appropriate.
- International enquiries are welcome; availability depends on time zone, fit, current physical location and the applicable local framework.

Languages:
- French
- English
- Spanish

Suggested factual description:
Sylviane Bahr is a humanistic and integrative therapist and ICF-certified coach based in Sant Cugat del Vallès, Barcelona. She supports adults and internationally mobile clients in English, French and Spanish, with in-person and online sessions.
